assumptions.statement: Users can request a password reset email for a registered account
assumptions.rationale: Suite exercises reset request flows via UI or API actions in reset-related tests

assumptions.statement: Invalid or expired reset tokens are rejected when completing reset
assumptions.rationale: Tests target invalid/expired token scenarios in titles and assertions

assumptions.statement: A valid reset token allows setting a new password
assumptions.rationale: Success-path reset completion tests imply end-to-end token consumption

assumptions.statement: New passwords must satisfy the configured password policy
assumptions.rationale: Policy/weak password tests assert rejection or validation messaging

assumptions.statement: Deleted or inactive accounts cannot complete password reset in the same way as active users
assumptions.rationale: Deleted-account scenarios in the suite encode differentiated expectations
